description: Check the document for an accessible (tagged) PDF before export. Read-only. Findings {check, severity error | warning, page, object_id, style, hint}: alt_text_missing (error), decorative_not_artifact (error), alt_text_hidden_by_group, alt_text_unverified, group_artifact_no_effect, parent_page_image (warnings); path_not_tagged (error: text frames with stroke or fill and tables with cell strokes, which InDesign writes as untagged paths – reported only with artifact_untagged_paths false – a tagged export marks them as artifacts by default); table_without_header_row (warning), table_header_scope (warning before InDesign 2026); style_without_pdf_tag (error for used paragraph styles that look like headings, by name or because their parent style has a heading tag – tags are not inherited); document_title_missing, text_language_missing, pdf_language_missing, pdf_language_invalid (errors; the PDF language is checked as given in pdf_language, otherwise from the preset or the export settings that export_pdf or – with interactive true – export_interactive_pdf would use); no_articles, item_outside_articles (warnings) and articles_not_used_for_pdf (error). Returns passed (no error), errors, warnings, findings[], findings_total, findings_truncated (max_findings, default 200), summary {images, images_ok, tables, objects_with_untagged_paths, paragraph_styles_used, styles_without_pdf_tag[], document_title, text_language, pdf_language, pdf_language_source, articles, use_for_tagged_pdf} and manual_steps[] – what only a person or Acrobat can do (captions bound to figures, complex tables, contrast, a check with a PDF/UA checker and a screen reader). export_pdf and export_interactive_pdf with pdfua_identifier true run this same check and add the PDF/UA identifier only when it reports no error.

artifact_untagged_paths.description: As planned for the export: true (default, as a tagged export does) – untagged paths will be marked as artifacts and path_not_tagged is not reported; false – they stay untagged and are reported as errors.

document_id.description: Document to act on, from list_documents or open_document. Without it the frontmost document is used. A document opened with show_window false is never the active one and must always be addressed by id.

interactive.description: Planned export is export_interactive_pdf (language from its export settings). Default false.

pdf_language.description: The PDF language planned for the export (checked like in export_pdf).

preset.description: The PDF preset planned for export_pdf (for its language). Default: the localized "High Quality Print".

name: check_accessibility
title: Check accessibility for PDF
